task_completion.description: Load the human PD-1/PD-L1 complex (PDB: 4ZQK) into PyMOL.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The PyMOL object list shows '4ZQK' or the structure is visible in the viewer.

task_completion.description: Identify and distinguish PD-1 and PD-L1 chains.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent uses commands or the GUI to select or rename chains (Chain A is PD-L1, Chain B is PD-1).

task_completion.description: Define interface residues on PD-L1 within 4.5 Å of PD-1.
task_completion.visual_evidence: Command line history or GUI selection showing a distance-based selection (e.g., 'select interface, chain A and (chain B around 4.5)').

task_completion.description: Apply distinct colors to chains and represent interface residues as sticks/surface and the rest as cartoon.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The viewer shows two differently colored proteins in cartoon mode, with specific residues on one chain highlighted as sticks or a surface.

task_completion.description: Save a high-resolution PNG figure to the specified path.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The command line shows a 'png' command targeting '~/PyMOL_Data/images/pd1_pdl1_interface.png'.

task_completion.description: Write a quantitative structural report with chain assignments, residue count, and hotspot confirmation.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The agent is seen typing into a text editor or using 'echo'/'write' commands to create '~/PyMOL_Data/pd1_pdl1_interface_report.txt' with the required data.

integrity.description: The agent interacted with the PyMOL software rather than just creating files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the PyMOL GUI active, 3D manipulation of the molecule, or PyMOL-specific commands being entered.

integrity.description: The agent calculates the interface count rather than guessing or using pre-known values without selection.
integrity.visual_evidence: The PyMOL feedback area (top text) shows the number of atoms or residues selected after the 'around' command is run.

integrity.description: The agent saves files to the specific directories requested in the task.
integrity.visual_evidence: Commands or file explorer views show the exact paths: ~/PyMOL_Data/images/ and ~/PyMOL_Data/.

privileged_info_for_vlm: For PDB 4ZQK: Chain A is PD-L1 and Chain B is PD-1. The interface residue count on PD-L1 (Chain A) using a 4.5 Å cutoff is approximately 18 residues. The four canonical hotspot residues on PD-L1 are Tyr56, Arg113, Met115, and Tyr123; these should be confirmed as present in the interface selection in the report.
